summary: Iteration 5 — verified the Expo Go crash reported by the user (unguarded expo-notifications module-scope calls) is now impossible. (1) STATIC GATE REVIEW of /app/frontend/src/lib/push.ts: all 7 expo-notifications entrypoints (setNotificationHandler L23, setNotificationChannelAsync L36, addNotificationResponseReceivedListener L54, getLastNotificationResponseAsync L62, requestPermissionsAsync L78, getDevicePushTokenAsync L80, getPermissionsAsync L95) are gated by `PUSH_AVAILABLE = Platform.OS !== 'web' && Constants.appOwnership !== 'expo'` and additionally wrapped in try/catch or .catch. AndroidImportance is only touched inside the same `if (Platform.OS === 'android' && PUSH_AVAILABLE)` block. usePushTapHandler and usePushNudge return early when !PUSH_AVAILABLE and only run inside useEffect. registerForPush also returns early. (2) RUNTIME PROOF via /app/frontend/tests/verify_push_expo_go_safe.sh: transpiles push.ts with esbuild and evaluates it in a mocked Node harness where `expo-notifications` is a Proxy whose ANY property access throws 'removed from Expo Go' — module loads cleanly, exports { registerForPush, usePushNudge, usePushTapHandler }, and registerForPush('uid') returns a no-op Promise. In a second harness with Constants.appOwnership='standalone' the same file DOES invoke setNotificationHandler + setNotificationChannelAsync exactly once at module scope, proving the gate flips correctly for dev-builds. Exit code 0 for both. (3) GREP SWEEP of app/ and src/ confirms no other file imports expo-notifications or references any of the 7 native call names — the guard covers the entire codebase. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) in package.json. (4) WEB REGRESSION at 390x844 vs iteration 4 baseline: http://localhost:3000 boots to the login screen ('Selamat datang kembali'); login with budi@dompet.test/password123 lands on /beranda with Saldo Bersama -Rp232.500, Pengeluaran per Kategori donut, Tren 6 Bulan line chart, Transaksi Terbaru list, notif badge (2). Tab-riwayat renders the transaction list (Semua/Kamu/Pasangan/Sep 2026 chips) — tap a row opens the Detail Transaksi bottom sheet (Jenis Pengeluaran, Nominal -Rp99.000, Kategori Makan, Diinput oleh Budi Test) with Edit Transaksi + Hapus Transaksi buttons; Edit Transaksi opens the edit sheet with Nominal input (99.000), category chips (Makan selected + Transport/Tagihan/Hiburan), Catatan, Simpan Perubahan, Batal — matches iter2 expected behavior. Only console error during the whole session is the expected push-relay 401 (placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY, known non-bug). No red-screen: `Cannot read property ErrorBoundary of undefined`, `Route ./_layout.tsx is missing the required default export`, and `expo-notifications ... removed from Expo Go` selectors all return null. (5) BACKEND regression: 19/19 pytest passed via localhost (auth email+phone, wallet pairing, invite validation, categories default+duplicate, transactions cross-user visibility, partner notification, summary period+owner filters, budget warning/exceeded thresholds, receipt upload+download).

Standalone/dev-build (appOwnership 'standalone' or null in bare) correctly enables push.
push.ts L21-33: module-scope setNotificationHandler is inside `if (PUSH_AVAILABLE)` AND try/catch — double-safe.
push.ts L35-41: module-scope setNotificationChannelAsync uses `.catch(...)` on the returned Promise so even a rejection won't unwind module init.
push.ts L49-73 usePushTapHandler: PUSH_AVAILABLE early-return inside useEffect, tapSub creation in try/catch, getLastNotificationResponseAsync uses optional-chaining call + .catch — cannot throw.
push.ts L75-85 registerForPush: PUSH_AVAILABLE early-return + full try/catch around requestPermissionsAsync + getDevicePushTokenAsync — cannot throw.
push.ts L89-116 usePushNudge: PUSH_AVAILABLE early-return + try/catch around getPermissionsAsync inside useEffect.

_layout.tsx L16 imports registerForPush/usePushNudge/usePushTapHandler — pure imports, no side effects at import beyond push.ts module-scope which is now safe. Line 76 additionally guards `Platform.OS !== 'web'` before calling registerForPush (belt-and-suspenders).
No other file in app/ or src/ imports expo-notifications — the guard is single-source-of-truth.

rca_of_issue: USER RCA: The three-error cascade in Expo Go on Android SDK 53+ ('Android Push notifications removed', 'Route ./_layout.tsx is missing the required default export', 'Cannot read property ErrorBoundary of undefined') was caused by /app/frontend/src/lib/push.ts calling Notifications.setNotificationHandler and Notifications.setNotificationChannelAsync at module scope. When _layout.tsx imports './push', the module evaluation threw synchronously, so _layout.tsx never registered its default export, which then made expo-router's useScreens read `undefined.ErrorBoundary`. Mitigation (already applied by main agent, verified this iteration): every native call in push.ts is now gated on `PUSH_AVAILABLE = Platform.OS !== 'web' && Constants.appOwnership !== 'expo'` AND wrapped in try/catch or .catch. Runtime harness proves that when expo-notifications is mocked to throw on every property access (mimicking Expo Go SDK-53), the module loads cleanly and exports its 3 functions. No code changes needed this iteration; only verification + a permanent test harness (verify_push_expo_go_safe.sh) for future regression.
